Following @Michael R Douglas 's suggestion to work on a TauCeti roadmap around vector bundles, connections, Higgs bundles, and moduli spaces, I started looking at what the full Kobayashi–Hitchin/non-abelian Hodge picture would actually require: Narasimhan–Seshadri, connections, Higgs bundles, stability, Simpson’s correspondence, and moduli spaces.

It quickly became clear that this would be enormous. I then tried to stop at characteristic classes, since this would at least lead to reusable intersection theory, but that already brought in projective bundles, Grassmannians, flag bundles, Chow groups, the projective bundle formula, the splitting principle... so that would have been enormous as well.

I finally decided to reduce it to the fundamental equivalences between quasi-coherent sheaves and affine linear schemes, and between finite locally free sheaves and geometric algebraic vector bundles, together with the relative-Spec and tensorial infrastructure needed to state them properly.

This is the self-contained algebraic first step. Projective, Grassmann, and flag bundles, characteristic classes, and cohomological realization are recorded as separate successors. Analytification/GAGA and the passage to holomorphic vector bundles would then provide a separate bridge towards connections, Higgs bundles, and the original non-abelian Hodge direction.

Here is the PR: https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/pull/297

I would be very happy if somebody could take a look. Any feedback, comments, or discussion about the scope and the proposed interfaces would be very welcome.
@Simone M Chiarello, just a follow-up that there are outstanding review comments on this one. Looking forward to getting this one in!

Thanks! The CI is green now and the README is readable. I have added an unrelated IntegralLattices file since that was the thing making the CI failing and the main branch has a [skip-ci]and I've seen in the commit history that the CI seems to be corrupted, so I took the freedom to add the file. I think this should also fix the CI. @Chris Birkbeck can we merge now?
So i dont understand, how did the integral lattices file help fix CI?

AlgebraicCodingTheory/Suggested.lean still imports TauCetiRoadmap.IntegralLattices.Suggested, but that file had been removed when the IntegralLattices roadmap was archived under Completed/. So lake build was failing first with no such file or directory, then with a bad import in AlgebraicCodingTheory.

Restoring the previous IntegralLattices/Suggested.lean made the full build green.

In this case I preferred to modify in the "add back" way rather than removing stuff which does not belong to my scope. Please let me know your opinion on that
This might be a question for @Kim Morrison as to whats best to do here.

Sorry, I don't understand. If IntegralLattices is complete, why don't you just have AlgebraicCodingTheory/Suggested.lean import the file from Completed/?

Or is IntegralLattices not actually complete, and you need something that was missed?

Yes, that surely fixes it. I had restored the old file as a conservative workaround because the build failure came from outside the scope of my PR so I didn't modify that AlgebraicCodingTheory file.

Anyway, this has meanwhile been fixed on main in #404 just as you suggested. I've now merged the latest main into my branch and removed the restored compatibility file, so the PR is back to only touching the AlgebraicVectorBundles roadmap files.

Thanks for pointing this out! Now I think all is sorted out for merge, please let me know if anything else is missing
